text:
Evan Bouchard is the Norris Trophy frontrunner in more than one place this month: NHL.com's Trophy Tracker and Daily Faceoff both put him first. He has 12 goals and 39 points in 26 games, plays more than 25 minutes a night, and with him on the ice at 5v5 Edmonton takes 57.6% of the attempts.

He also came within a game of a Paul Coffey record. Bouchard opened the season with points in 11 straight road games, one short of the mark for defensemen, as ClutchPoints noted, and was held off the sheet in Tampa on Nov. 19 with the record in reach.

The goals are the part that won't hold at this rate. He has 12 on 4.4 expected, shooting 18% after 10% last season, and the Oilers have scored 26.7 more goals than expected with him out there. Our talent range has his finishing near 9.3%, and the last ten games show the drift: three goals and 11 points against 12.5 expected.

What holds up is the play driving. Evolving-Hockey had him fifth among 215 defensemen last season at 3.3 wins above replacement, and our wins-added measure ranks him seventh in the league.
